- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27330-27334 and 27393-27399 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The reassertion guard uses an loose check for the release marker: `(contains("<!-- ai:needs-human-auto-release ") | not)`.
  WHY: A trusted comment can re-assert `ai:needs-human` (e.g., "re-adding `ai:needs-human`...") and simultaneously include a malformed or unrelated marker, such as `<!-- ai:needs-human-auto-release invalid -->`. Because the loose check only looks for the prefix and does not validate the full marker structure, it incorrectly classifies this comment as a release marker rather than a re-assertion, causing the poller to remove `ai:needs-human` when it should have kept the PR latched.

  WHY: Any trusted comment that mentions both the literal `ai:needs-human` and the marker prefix anywhere in its body is exempted from being treated as a re-latch, so the poller can delete `ai:needs-human` even though a trusted actor just re-asserted the hold.
